content.introduction: Algebra uses letters and symbols to represent numbers. It helps us solve problems when we do not know the value of a number.

sections.heading: 1. Understanding variables
sections.text: A variable is a letter that represents an unknown or changing number. Common variables include x, y and a.
sections.example: In x + 3 = 8, the letter x represents the unknown number.

sections.heading: 2. Solving a simple equation
sections.text: To find x in x + 3 = 8, subtract 3 from both sides. This gives x = 5.

sections.heading: 3. Remember the rule
sections.text: Whatever operation you perform on one side of an equation, perform the same operation on the other side to keep the equation balanced.

content.summary: A variable represents an unknown number. Use inverse operations to solve simple equations.

xh.title: Intshayelelo kwi-Aljebra
xh.introduction: I-Aljebra isebenzisa oonobumba neempawu ukumela amanani. Isinceda ukusombulula iingxaki xa singalazi ixabiso lenani.

sections.heading: 1. Ukuqonda izinto eziguquguqukayo
sections.text: Into eguquguqukayo ngunobumba omele inani elingaziwayo, njengo x okanye u y.
sections.example: Ku x + 3 = 8, u x umele inani esingalaziyo.

sections.heading: 2. Ukusombulula i-equation elula
sections.text: Ukuze ufumane u x ku x + 3 = 8, thabatha u 3 kumacala omabini. Ufumana u x = 5.

sections.heading: 3. Khumbula umthetho
sections.text: Yenza umsebenzi ofanayo kumacala omabini e-equation ukuze ihlale ilinganisiwe.

xh.summary: Into eguquguqukayo imele inani elingaziwayo. Sebenzisa imisebenzi echaseneyo ukusombulula ii-equation ezilula.

quiz.question: What is a variable in algebra?
options: A number that is always zero
A mathematical symbol for addition only
quiz.explanation: A variable is a letter or symbol used to represent a number.

content.introduction: A function is a mathematical relationship that assigns exactly one output to each allowed input.

sections.heading: 1. Function notation
sections.text: The notation f(x) means the output of a function f for an input x. For example, if f(x) = 2x + 1, substitute the input value for x.

sections.heading: 2. Finding function values
sections.text: To calculate a function value, replace every x in the rule with the given number and simplify.

sections.heading: 3. Domain and range
sections.text: The domain is the set of allowed input values. The range is the set of output values produced by those inputs.

content.summary: Substitute input values into a function rule to calculate outputs. Understand the difference between domain and range.

xh.title: Ukuqonda iiFankshini
xh.introduction: Ifankshini lubudlelwane bemathematika obunika isiphumo esinye kuphela kwigalelo ngalinye elivumelekileyo.

sections.heading: 1. Indlela yokubhala ifankshini
sections.text: U f(x) uthetha isiphumo sefankshini xa igalelo lingu x. Ukuba f(x) = 2x + 1, faka inani elinikiweyo endaweni ka x.

sections.heading: 2. Ukufumana ixabiso lefankshini
sections.text: Faka inani elinikiweyo endaweni ka x uze wenze izibalo.

sections.heading: 3. I-domain ne-range
sections.text: I-domain luluhlu lwamagalelo avumelekileyo. I-range luluhlu lweziphumo ezifunyenweyo.

xh.summary: Faka amanani kumthetho wefankshini ukuze ufumane iziphumo. Qonda umahluko phakathi kwe-domain ne-range.

quiz.question: If g(x) = x², what is g(5)?
What does the domain of a function describe?
quiz.explanation: The domain is the set of input values for which the function is defined.

content.introduction: Differential calculus studies how quickly a quantity changes. The derivative can describe the gradient of a curve at a point.

sections.heading: 1. What is a derivative?
sections.text: The derivative measures the instantaneous rate of change of a function. On a graph, it represents the gradient of the tangent to the curve at a point.

sections.heading: 2. The power rule
sections.text: For a power function f(x) = xⁿ, the derivative is f'(x) = nxⁿ⁻¹. Multiply by the original exponent, then reduce the exponent by one.

sections.heading: 3. A worked example
sections.example: f'(x) = 6x² + 8x - 5. The derivative of a constant is zero.

content.summary: Use the power rule to differentiate polynomial terms. The derivative represents the gradient of a curve and the rate at which a function changes.

xh.title: Intshayelelo kwi-Differential Calculus
xh.introduction: I-differential calculus ifunda indlela ubungakanani obutshintsha ngayo. I-derivative ingabonisa ithambeka legophe kwindawo ethile.

sections.heading: 1. Yintoni i-derivative?
sections.text: I-derivative ilinganisa izinga lotshintsho lomsebenzi wemathematika. Kwigrafu, ibonisa ithambeka lomgca ochukumisa igophe kwindawo ethile.

sections.heading: 2. Umthetho we-power
sections.text: Kumsebenzi f(x) = xⁿ, i-derivative ngu f'(x) = nxⁿ⁻¹. Phindaphinda nge-exponent uze unciphise i-exponent ngesinye.

sections.heading: 3. Umzekelo osebenzayo
sections.text: Fumana i-derivative ka f(x) = 2x³ + 4x² - 5x + 7 ngokusebenza kwigama ngalinye.
sections.example: f'(x) = 6x² + 8x - 5. I-derivative yenani elisisigxina ngu zero.

xh.summary: Sebenzisa umthetho we-power ukufumana ii-derivative zee-polynomial. I-derivative ibonisa ithambeka legophe nezinga lotshintsho.

quiz.question: What is the derivative of f(x) = x²?
quiz.explanation: Using the power rule, the derivative of x² is 2x.

quiz.question: What is the derivative of a constant such as f(x) = 8?
quiz.explanation: A constant does not change as x changes, so its derivative is zero.
